findings.title: A declared but unstarted required peer is treated as an empty successful comparison set
findings.claimRejected: Q4: required peer evidence unavailable implies unknown and zero provider starts.
findings.sourceStatus: Established by static owner-path analysis; no code was executed.
findings.contractInterpretation: For author_and_peer_distinct, required peers are the other declared slots sharing the assessor slot's coverage criterion, as peerSlots already defines. This does not require unrelated plan slots. TASK.md:11/13 and rubric Q4 require refusal when that required evidence is unavailable. Neither ROOT_POLICY_HOW_SELECTION nor ROOT_SCOPE_CLARIFICATION grants an exception for the first peer. Candidate HOW:96 and author R5 disclose an actual-occurrence-only rule; they do not supersede that selected condition.

premises: A valid admitted two-slot plan with sharedCoverage=declared_independent_peers, one shared criterion, distinct published role actorRefs and author_and_peer_distinct on both slots.
The current selected-no-evidence assessor call, input digest, prefix, catalog, source inventory and native author correspondence all authenticate through the existing owner.
The authenticated construction author is the exact declared codex/gpt-6-astra profile; the prepared current assessor is the exact declared claude/claude-opus-5-5 profile.
The other declared peer slot has no actor_invocation_started occurrence at the current predecessor prefix. No future peer identity or J is supplied.
sourceDerivation: qualificationPlanMatches permits the two-slot shape (qualification.ts:627-634; existing plan test at :425).
peerSlots returns the other slot; admittedPeerSelections appends only for actual starts, so it returns [].
qualificationAssessorEligibility passes [] because the declared peer-slot list is nonempty.
decideQualificationDispatchEligibility rejects peers===null, but the empty loop performs no comparisons and returns eligible.
actor_process accepts eligible and continues to the binding/start path after the gate.
controlledOwnerInput.expected: unknown(required_peer_missing), before any binding/start; zero dependent provider starts.
controlledOwnerInput.executionClaim: No provider start was observed or attempted in this review. The source permits one when the other existing preparation premises hold.

impact.triggerProbability: Deterministic for the first otherwise eligible call of a valid peer-required plan when its peer has not started; conditional on this selected path being used.
impact.sunnyDay: Ordinary work and author_distinct assessments are unaffected. The first peer-required assessment can incur a paid invocation before its independence prerequisite exists.
impact.realizedHarm: Source counterexample only; no claimed observed charge or production failure.
impact.failClosedControls: A started peer without admitted transport evidence becomes null/unknown. Completed J resolution again checks every selected peer and refuses missing or same-family proof. This finding does not establish a green qualification bypass.
impact.distinction: Missing prerequisite evidence at the first call is the defect; a later actual same-family peer refusal is a separate correctly fail-closed outcome.

repairBoundary.size: Small bounded owner/policy correction plus one missing-declared-peer actual-gate negative. Preserve slot missingness rather than interpreting no actual occurrences as permission; an empty-list check alone is not a general substitute for required-slot completeness.
repairBoundary.causalDiscriminator: Valid declared peer plan with no peer start must return unknown and prove zero starts through the existing actual actor gate. Preserve existing known-peer, author and ordinary-work cases.
repairBoundary.rabbitHoleRisk: Low if confined to truthful missingness. No new routing, model family, registry, production positive peer construction or historical attribution redesign is implied.
